name: Aiko Tanaka
bio:
Aiko Tanaka's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not with a childhood fascination with racing, but with a deep appreciation for organizational efficiency. After graduating with a degree in Human Resources, she spent several years honing her skills in various corporate environments. A chance encounter with a motorsport executive at a conference sparked her interest in the unique challenges and rewards of managing talent within the fast-paced world of racing. 

Aiko joined Elite Motorsport five years ago, bringing a fresh perspective to their HR department. She is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her unwavering commitment to fostering a positive and productive work environment. Aiko believes in the power of clear communication, fair treatment, and continuous professional development to unlock the full potential of every team member. Her approach is not just about filling positions, but about building a cohesive team that shares a passion for excellence. What sets her apart is her ability to see the bigger picture, aligning HR strategies with the overall goals of the racing team, ensuring that talent management is an integral part of their success.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Aiko has a calm and professional demeanor that is reflected in her neat appearance.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas
Has a particular fondness for green tea and drinks it throughout the day
Insists on personally conducting exit interviews to gather feedback and improve employee retention
